d:
Anand Mohan ki samaypurv rihaee radd hone ke bad bihar ki rajniti men aarop-pratyarop tej ho gae hain. RJD neta aur neta pratipaksh Tejashwi Yadav ne is mamle men BJP aur JDU par nishana sadha hai. unhonne aarop lagaya ki Anand Mohan ko dobara jel bhejne ke pichhe BJP aur JDU ka hath hai.
Supreme Court ke phaisle ke bad Tejashwi ke is bayan ne bihar ki siyasat men naee bahas chher di hai. halanki, BJP aur JDU ki bhumika ko lekar lagaya gaya yah aarop Tejashwi Yadav ka rajnitik dava hai.
